history.desc: Connected apps are read only: Hearth blocks any app tool that isn't clearly read-only, reads apps only when the user asks, and keeps app tokens encrypted.

mentions.anchor: but only when you ask, never on its own.
Reads your apps, never writes.** Calendar, Gmail, Notion, Linear and more. Hearth blocks any app tool that isn't clearly read-only.
Tokens and keys are stored encrypted with Electron `safeStorage`
App sign-in tokens, and keys you enter in Hearth, are kept there too, encrypted. The API keys in your `.env` file are plain text, so keep that file to yourself.
